name: Energie - main vocabulary
description: Basic terms for users in energetic sectors. To explore official translations and definitions and industry-specific terminology in depth, follow us with next package.
author: Techdoc

words.definition: The power used for doing work or producing heat and light.

contextSentences.en: Germany has invested billions in developing and expanding renewable energy sources.
According to the law of conservation of energy, energy can never be created or destroyed.

words.example_en: This experiment shows how energy works.
words.example_sk: Tento experiment ukazuje, ako funguje energia.

words.definition: A form of energy caused by the movement of electric charges.

contextSentences.en: Benjamin Franklin famously demonstrated that lightning is a form of electricity.
Millions of people in developing countries still lack access to reliable electricity.

words.example_en: The teacher explained the term electricity.

words.definition: The force that pushes electric current through a circuit.

contextSentences.en: High-voltage power lines transmit electricity over long distances with minimal energy loss.
Working with a voltage of 400 volts requires strict safety precautions.

words.example_en: We studied the concept of voltage yesterday.

words.definition: The flow of electric charge through a conductor.

contextSentences.en: In a simple circuit, electric current flows from the positive to the negative terminal.
During a thunderstorm, you should avoid touching electrical appliances to prevent electric shock.

words.definition: A facility where electricity is generated.

contextSentences.en: A hydroelectric power plant generates clean energy by harnessing the force of flowing water.
Germany plans to shut down all coal-fired power plants by 2038.

words.example_en: We studied the concept of power plant yesterday.

words.definition: A device that converts sunlight into electrical energy.

contextSentences.en: Installing solar panels on a rooftop typically pays for itself within about ten years.
New perovskite solar panels promise higher efficiency than conventional silicon models.

words.example_en: The teacher explained the term solar panel.

words.definition: A device that stores electrical energy for later use.

contextSentences.en: Lithium-ion batteries power smartphones, laptops, and electric vehicles.
Developing more powerful batteries is key to the success of electric mobility.

words.example_en: We studied the concept of battery yesterday.

contextSentences.en: In an emergency, the diesel generator switches on automatically when the power fails.
A generator converts kinetic energy into electrical energy.

words.example_en: The teacher explained the term generator.

words.definition: A machine with blades that converts moving fluid into power.

contextSentences.en: Steam turbines are used in nuclear and coal power plants to generate electricity.
The blades of a turbine must be extremely heat-resistant as they handle hot steam or gas.

words.example_en: The turbine is important in this field.
words.example_sk: Turbína je v tejto oblasti dôležitý.

words.definition: Able to be naturally replaced and used again.

contextSentences.en: Renewable energy sources such as wind and solar will never run out, unlike coal or oil.
The share of renewable energy in Germany's electricity mix has already exceeded 50 per cent.

words.example_en: The renewable is important in this field.
words.example_sk: Obnoviteľný je v tejto oblasti dôležitý.

words.definition: The ability to produce good results without wasting energy.

contextSentences.en: Better insulation can greatly increase the energy efficiency of buildings.
Modern LED bulbs are about five times more efficient than traditional incandescent lights.

words.example_en: We studied the concept of efficiency yesterday.

words.definition: The amount of energy, fuel, or electricity used.

contextSentences.en: Energy consumption per capita is much higher in industrialised countries than in developing ones.
Simple energy-saving measures can reduce household consumption by up to 30 per cent.

words.example_en: The teacher explained the term consumption.

words.definition: A network for delivering electricity from producers to users.

contextSentences.en: The European electricity grid is the largest synchronous AC network in the world.
Smart technology enables better monitoring and control of the grid in real time.

words.example_en: The teacher explained the term grid.

words.definition: A substance released into the air, especially by burning fuel.

contextSentences.en: The EU has set strict limits on the emission of pollutants from motor vehicles.
Filter technology can significantly reduce harmful emissions from industrial plants.

words.definition: A material that is burned or used to produce energy.

contextSentences.en: Biofuel produced from plants is seen as a more climate-neutral alternative to fossil fuels.
The price of fuel fluctuates considerably depending on the political situation in oil-producing countries.

words.example_en: We studied the concept of fuel yesterday.
